name: The Dunlin, Kiawah River, Auberge Collection
positioning: Riverside Auberge Collection hotel, officially called The Dunlin, on the Kiawah River at Johns Island, about 40 minutes from downtown Charleston
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet riverside stay with a farm, trails and boat and paddle activities
Families and groups wanting suites or private riverfront bungalows

facts.text: The Dunlin is at 6000 Kiawah River Drive, Johns Island, South Carolina, about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.
The Dunlin is named after a local shorebird.
The interiors are by Amanda Lindroth Design.
The architect was Robert Glazier, with a focus on Sea Island architecture.
Rooms have a cottage-inspired look with white-washed walls, honey oak floors, mint green accents and textural linen fabrics.
Generous porches offer riverfront views over the marshlands.
The suites have outdoor soaking tubs.
The Riverfront Bungalows have kitchenettes, furnished porches and fenced-in yards.
The Cove is a riverfront pool club with a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.
Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, fly fishing, boat excursions, biking, exploring the farm and birdwatching.
Epicurean Experiences include pop-up farm dinners and riverside oyster roasts.

highlights.text: The property has an onsite farm and waterfront hiking trails.
The architect was Robert Glazier, with a focus on Sea Island architecture.
The Cove is a riverfront pool club with a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.
Linnette's menu is seafood-forward, built around the catch of the day from local fishermen.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.
Traffic can be expected on the drive from downtown Charleston at commuting hours.
Charleston International Airport is 30 miles and 45 minutes from The Dunlin.
